note: Alberta Parks recreation area on Medicine Lake, 47 km north of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy 22 then 12 km southeast on a gravel access road, run by Westward Bound Campgrounds: four loops (A-D) along the shore, most sites surrounded by trees, with a boat launch, pier, fish-cleaning station and playground. Informal OHV trails are nearby; OHVs must stay on trailers within the recreation area. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 48 unserviced sites at $28, season May 8 - Oct 3 (2026), reservable 90 days ahead with six first-come sites, vault toilets and unsafe pump water. Added season dates, max length 72 ft, pull-throughs, FCFS sites in booking.note; note rewritten without 'lakeside'. Lakeview kept with a lakefront lead; OHV wording and phone flagged.
flags: OHV (drop-candidate check - read as a general campground with an OHV side): the agency says 'Launch your canoe or boat to fish, visit the playground or explore informal OHV trails nearby. Please keep OHVs on trailers in the recreation area.' The campground is not described as part of or at the trailhead of an OHV trail system, and OHVs may not be ridden in the recreation area.
ROAD: the agency says only '47 km north of Rocky Mountain House on Hwy. 22 and 12 km southeast on a gravel access road' - no warning, restriction or closure stated. Not researched further.

WATERFRONT (stored lakeview - confirmed, with a lakefront lead not acted on): the agency says 'Many of the sites are surrounded by trees for privacy, and a few are located next to the lake'; the shop tags A-01, A-03, A-05, A-07, B-16, B-17, B-19, B-20, C-31-C-35, C-37 and the group site 'Near Water'. On Esri imagery (1 m/px) the loops run along the shore road under continuous canopy; at Loop C's south-west corner (about 52.7466,-114.7426) a cluster of RVs sits on an open gravel/sand clearing roughly 20-35 m from the water - probably the tagged C-31 to C-35 - and on the shore road north of it pads lie 10-20 m from the water under trees. A reviewer with better imagery could make the C cluster a 'few clearly waterfront sites' case; not upgraded here.
PHONE (stored empty): page 'Information: 1-855-721-3975', 'Facility Operator: Westward Bound Campgrounds' (the tear sheet gives the same number).
PIN (stored 52.74936,-114.74370 = the agency's directions point): in the forest among Loops A/B, inside the campground - no move.
SHORT SITE: D-48 is listed at 22 ft; every other site is 28 ft or more.
No seniors-discount line on this page. No current advisory posted.
